name: How long does a custom deck design and construction project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom deck design and construction project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom deck design and construction project varies depending on its complexity, size, material choices, and the time required for permit approvals. A smaller, simpler deck might take a few weeks for construction, while a large, multi-level deck with extensive features could extend to several months. Our managed process includes detailed scheduling transparency, and we work diligently to minimize disruptions. We provide a clear project timeline upfront, accounting for design, permit coordination, and construction phases to set realistic expectations for your high-end outdoor living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration for a custom deck varies by complexity and size, typically ranging from weeks to months. We provide transparent scheduling, accounting for design, permits, and construction.
